subject: 🎓 Graduation RSVP update — $ceremony_name ($total_going going)
body:
Hello Graduation Office,

This is an automated attendance update for an upcoming graduation ceremony. It was triggered by the latest RSVP from $recorded_student (response: $recorded_status).
